source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Which information helps Claude Code decide which skill to load for your task?

options.feedback: The name and description help identify a relevant skill. Detailed instructions are loaded when needed.

options.text: The full text of every available skill
options.feedback: The notes say that the name and description help decide what to load, with detailed instructions loaded when needed. Reading all skill instructions first reverses that distinction.

options.text: The output from the most recent skill run
options.feedback: A past output can help you evaluate a procedure, but the notes identify the skill name and description as information used for discovery.

options.text: The model's size and training objective
options.feedback: These describe the model, rather than which skill matches your task. A skill's name and description help with that selection.
